SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.title: Picnic for Two
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.INITIAL.de:
A sunny clearing, a checkered blanket and a basket packed far too full.

Someone planned this. There are bamboo shoots, eucalyptus sandwiches and exactly enough for two... [sine]if nobody gets greedy.[/sine]
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.SHARE.desc:
You split every bite down the middle. The food runs out fast, but nobody minds.

You both feel [green]refreshed[/green].
SPIREDUO-PICNIC_FOR_TWO.pages.FEAST.desc:
While your partner watches the clouds, the basket quietly empties.

[sine]You feel very full.[/sine]
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.title: Stargazing
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.INITIAL.descri:
Far from the noise of the Spire, you find a quiet hill under a sky full of stars.

You lie down side by side. For a while, nobody says anything.

Then a [gold]shooting star[/gold] streaks across the sky.
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.MAKE_A_PROMISE:
You hook your little fingers together and make a promise under the stars.

Whatever waits up there, you'll face it [gold]together[/gold].
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.pages.WISH.descripti:
You sprint down the hill toward where the star fell, trip over a root and tumble the rest of the way.

At the bottom, something is [gold]glowing[/gold] in the grass.
SPIREDUO-STARGAZING.loss: {character} chased a falling star at [gold]{event}[/gold] and never came back.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.title: Little Quarrel
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.pages.INITIAL.de:
It started with something small. Who ate the last bamboo shoot? Whose turn was it to keep watch?

Now you're sitting back to back, arms crossed, and neither of you wants to speak first.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.pages.INITIAL.op: Add [gold]Make Up[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
Lose [red]{Damage}[/red] HP. Remove [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
"...Sorry."

A long pause. Then a small voice behind you: "Me too."

The air feels [green]lighter[/green] already.
You stomp off into the woods and kick a tree. It hurts. A lot.

By the time you come back, your head is [gold]clear[/gold] and you've forgotten what the fight was about.
SPIREDUO-LITTLE_QUARREL.loss: {character} stormed off at [gold]{event}[/gold] and never came back.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.title: Photo Booth
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.descr:
Wedged between two crumbling pillars is a [gold]photo booth[/gold], its curtain half open and its lights still blinking.

Nobody knows who put it here. It still takes coins.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.INITIAL.optio: Pay [red]{Gold}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Duplicate a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.PHOTO.descrip:
Flash! The booth whirs and prints two copies of the photo.

One for each of you.
SPIREDUO-PHOTO_BOOTH.pages.SILLY_FACES.d:
You pull the silliest faces you can manage. The booth flashes, sputters and refuses to print.

Still, laughing that hard makes you feel [gold]stronger[/gold].
